title: Username at 256 characters and 1 character
why: Tests both ends of the username length range.

steps.does: POST …/identity/register-user twice with otherwise valid, distinct passengers: first with a UserName of 256 'u' characters (Email long.user@example.com), then with UserName 'a' (Email short.user@example.com).

expect: Both registrations succeed. The first saved UserName is 256 characters long and the second is the single character 'a'. Two User rows are created.
